name: DoFun head units (TWCore)
about: Units carrying DoFun's TWCore system app. Kaspersky's 2026 report found TWCore used to install the JarService malware (com.tw.jar1).
limitations: Which other com.tw apps carry vehicle functions is not known, so all of them stay Protected (data/protected.json).
restore_notes: pm enable com.tw.core brings the updater back.
